name: NEONTRIP Supplier Order Confirmation Email v0.1 (INACTIVE DRAFT)

parameters.content: Inactive draft for Sales-Vergabe AB-PDF emails. Triggered only by the Ops app button through SUPPLIER_ORDER_CONFIRMATION_WEBHOOK_URL. The Ops app generates the PDF from offer_snapshot, reserves idempotency before side effect, and sends a bounded payload. This workflow validates the payload, sends via Outlook using Fabienne/NEONTRIP signature, and returns providerMessageId. Do not use Outlook Email Trigger here; that is for inbound mail and would not represent an explicit operator action.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, status: 'rejected', error: $json.error, saleId: $json.saleId || null, idempotencyKey: $json.idempotencyKey || null }) }}
